mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a peculiar chemical species and in contrast to proton which has small size, it is unusually large."
Hydride ion is a peculiar chemical species and in contrast to proton which has small size, it is unusually large.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most abundant metal in sea water (Ml.08%)."
Sodium as sodium chloride is the most abundant metal in sea water (Ml.08%).

Hydrogen is the first element of the periodic table, with an electronic configuration of 1S1 this electronic configuration is similar to the outer electronic configuration of the alkali metals (ns1).

Atomic radii are the measure of the size of the atom.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in some underground high voltage transmission applications."
Sodium in polyethylene enclosed cables is used in some underground high voltage transmission applications.

Lithium is the highest of all the metallic elements i.

S-block elements are known to be very reactive metals and generally form ionic compounds.

Potassium is a major component of plant fertilizers, where it is used in form of chloride and nitrate salts.

Hydrogen like electricity is a secondary source of energy because it is produced using energy from a primary source such as coal, nuclear fission or sun. ii.
